name: ts-fix-negative-allocate
prompt: Bug report: allocate(money(-100, "USD"), [1, 1, 1]) returns shares that add up to -99: a cent disappears. Fix it the /sdlc-fix way (failing test first). Run npm test.

checks.run: node --input-type=module -e "import {money,allocate} from './src/index.ts'; for (const [a,r] of [[-100,[1,1,1]],[-7,[2,3]],[100,[1,1,1]],[-1,[1,1]]]) { const s=allocate(money(a,'USD'),r).reduce((x,m)=>x+m.amount,0n); if (s!==BigInt(a)) process.exit(1) }"
